title: Automated Root Cause Analysis for FinTech Microservices
business: A high-frequency trading platform engineering team managing distributed microservices.
problem: Engineers spend excessive time manually correlating stack traces across fragmented service logs during production incidents, leading to delayed resolution of critical transaction failures.
solution: By integrating the Sentry MCP connector with Claude, the team enables an AI agent to programmatically query Sentry issues, fetch event details, and trigger the Seer Issue Fix tool to generate automated root cause analysis directly within the chat interface.
steps: Configure the Sentry MCP server with appropriate API credentials to allow Claude access to specific project scopes.
Use find_issues to identify high-frequency errors occurring in the production environment.
Invoke get_issue_details to retrieve the specific stack trace and context for a selected error.
Execute analyze_issue_with_seer to generate an automated root cause analysis and potential remediation steps.
Review the AI-generated findings and apply updates to the issue status using update_issue.
outcome: The team achieves a more streamlined debugging workflow where context-rich error data is synthesized into actionable insights, reducing the cognitive load on developers during incident response.
limitation: The Seer analysis is dependent on the quality and breadth of the captured Sentry event data; if the error context is insufficient or the stack trace is obfuscated, the AI's root cause suggestions may lack precision. This can be verified by checking the event attachment details to ensure sufficient breadcrumbs exist.
